messages.text: The reference scope confirms that structured values and pipeline commands are the stable boundary: parsing alone is insufficient because rendering and conversion flags determine exact bytes. I’m narrowing the implementation to a real expression/pipeline evaluator covering the benchmark domains, while sampling the official binary for output and error conventions; a wrong direction would be hard-coding test strings instead of modeling Nushell values and commands.

commands.commandLine: {"command":"$nu=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $cases=@('1 + 2 * 3','[1 2 3] | math sum','[1 2 3] | math avg','[3 1 2] | math min','[3 1 2] | math max','\"hello\" | str upcase','\"  hi  \" | str trim','\"banana\" | str replace a X','\"abc\" | str contains b','\"héllo\" | str length'); foreach($c in $cases){$o=& $nu --no-config-file -c $c 2>&1; \"CASE=$c`nSTATUS=$LASTEXITCODE`nOUT=<$($o -join \"`n\")>\"}","workdir":"C:\\Users\\liuliu\\Documents\\tura-benchmark\\raw\\project-rebuild-source-port\\r-704151578f\\nushell\\tura-direct-1\\workspace"}
commands.preview: $nu=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $cases=@('1 + 2 * 3','[1 2 3] | math sum','[1 2 3] | math avg','[3 1 2] | math min','[3 1 2] | math max','"hello" | str upcase','"  hi  " | str trim','"banana" | str replace a X','"abc" | str contains b','"héllo" | str length'); foreach($c in $cases){$o=& $nu --no-config-file -c $c 2>&1; "CASE=$c`nSTATUS=$LASTEXITCODE`nOUT=<$($o -join "`n")>"}

commands.commandLine: {"command":"$nu=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $cases=@('{a: 1, b: \"x\"} | to json','{a: 1, b: \"x\"} | to json -r','[[a b]; [1 x] [2 y]] | to json -r','\"{\\\"a\\\":1}\" | from json | get a','\"a,b`n1,x`n2,y\" | from csv | to json -r','[[a b]; [1 x] [2 y]] | to csv'); foreach($c in $cases){$outFile=[IO.Path]::GetTempFileName();$errFile=[IO.Path]::GetTempFileName();$p=Start-Process $nu -ArgumentList @('--no-config-file','-c',$c) -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $outFile -RedirectStandardError $errFile; $ob=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($outFile);$eb=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($errFile); \"CASE=$c`nSTATUS=$($p.ExitCode)`nSTDOUT=$([Convert]::ToHexString($ob))`nSTDERR=$([Convert]::ToHexString($eb))\"; Remove-Item $outFile,$errFile}","workdir":"C:\\Users\\liuliu\\Documents\\tura-benchmark\\raw\\project-rebuild-source-port\\r-704151578f\\nushell\\tura-direct-1\\workspace"}
commands.preview: $nu=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $cases=@('{a: 1, b: "x"} | to json','{a: 1, b: "x"} | to json -r','[[a b]; [1 x] [2 y]] | to json -r','"{\"a\":1}" | from json | get a','"a,b`n1,x`n2,y" | from csv | to json -r','[[a b]; [1 x] [2 y]] | to csv'); foreach($c in $cases){$outFile=[IO.Path]::GetTempFileName();$errFile=[IO.Path]::GetTempFileName();$p=Start-Process $nu -ArgumentList @('--no-config-file','-c',$c) -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $outFile -RedirectStandardError $errFile; $ob=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($outFile);$eb=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($errFile); "CASE=$c`nSTATUS=$($p.ExitCode)`nSTDOUT=$([Convert]::ToHexString($ob))`nSTDERR=$([Convert]::ToHexString($eb))"; Remove-Item $outFile,$errFile}
